infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FitForm uses the camera to record workout sets you choose to analyze for exercise form feedback.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FitForm records microphone audio only when you record a workout video in the app.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FitForm lets you select workout videos from your library so they can be uploaded for form analysis.
